-Consolidated results for qtr and year ended Mar 31,2026 approved in meeting on April 30, 2026. Auditor expressed unmodified opinion
-Results prepared using IndAS u/s 133 of the Co. Act, 2013 read with Co IndAS Rules 2015
- Results on BSE/NSE site & on Co.’s site.
- Scheme of amalgamation amongst subsidiaries Busy, Hello and Tolexo was approved by the respective BOD and approved by NCLT Chandigarh Bench via order dated 17-01-25. Order filed with ROC on Feb 14 2025. As per this it doesn’t affect to console results for the year Mar 21, 2025. Tolexo filed application for name change to Busy and approved on 21-03-2025.
- During period, granted 406,730 SAR to employees at a weighted avg share price of 2,245 per share, exercise price of 10 each, vesting period of 5 years.
- During period, carried out an impact assessment of new Labour Codes resulted in increase in the provision for employee benefits by Rs. 90.72 (Gratuity by Rs. 55.17 and leave benefits by Rs. 35.55). Govt in the process of notifying related rules & impact will be evaluated and accounted as per
applicable accounting standards in the period of notification.
- Dividend Declared – 30 per share final dividend and 30 per share as special dividend for the year ended 31 Mar 2026 subject to shareholders approval in AGM.
